title: What If the Moon Disappeared? (Built in Toy Bricks)
description: What would happen if the Moon vanished tonight? We build it brick by brick: the first second, the tides, darker nights, the end of eclipses, longer days and Earth's wobbly tilt.
sources: Moon size, distance, recession and the Earth-Moon balance point: Wikipedia, Orbit of the Moon
Sun's tides about 44-46% of the Moon's: HyperPhysics, Tides
Tides lengthen the day by about 1.7 ms per century; ~385-day years 350 million years ago: Scientific American
Corals sense full-moon light before mass spawning: ScienceDaily (University of Queensland, 2007)
Tilt without the Moon: Laskar et al. 1993 (large, chaotic) vs Lissauer et al. 2011 (about 10 degrees)
footer: Which what-if should we build next? Tell us in the comments!
